name: 15356-prefillheavy-qwen8b-tp2
model: Qwen/Qwen3-8B. Ungated; bf16, ~16 GB of weights, already in the local HF cache.
hardware: 2x H100 80GB HBM3 of ONE a3 node (--gres=gpu:2). No router, no external cache tier.
load_profile: concurrent (closed loop), streams=64, warmup the first 30%, bounded at 3000 requests with a 1200 s safety cap.
workload: guidellm `synthetic_text` over `/v1/completions`, single turn, no prefix structure: ~480-token prompts (stdev 40, clamped 320-500) generating ~24 tokens (stdev 4, clamped 16-48), seed 42, prompts unique so prefix reuse is ~0.
purpose: An 8-billion-parameter document classifier returning short verdicts on page-length inputs, 64 concurrent streams across two GPUs.
launch:
# sglang at commit b6702d72cf0289eb2b2373bc8d6709b237e48876.
#
# `chunked-prefill-size` and `piecewise-cuda-graph-max-tokens` are part of the declared workload,
# not tuning knobs: changing either changes the benchmark rather than tuning it.
#
# host / port / served-model-name are deliberately absent -- they belong to whatever starts the
# server and waits for /health.

model-path: Qwen/Qwen3-8B
tp-size: 2
enable-piecewise-cuda-graph: true
chunked-prefill-size: 512
piecewise-cuda-graph-max-tokens: 512
context-length: 8192
mem-fraction-static: 0.85
random-seed: 42
